fn: No change for phones and tablets: field logging, packets and backups work as before.
ds: Project screen: when DS opens it shows your projects (Ongoing, Recent, Completed, Archived) with progress, backup status and View / Edit. Create a new project, open a backup file as a view-only project, or import field packets.
Each project keeps its own data on this computer (logs, maps, photos, schedules). Your existing data is the first project.

Viewer and Editor modes: projects open in Viewer mode and nothing can be changed or saved. Press Edit and enter the manager PIN to edit; it returns to Viewer after 10 idle minutes. The app lock PIN also unlocks any project.
Importing while in Viewer mode saves a safety backup file first.
Project menu: Projects, Switch Editor / Viewer mode, Change manager PIN. A VIEW ONLY / EDITOR tag shows at the top.
